final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS n FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.tradekind, s.n, 1.0 * s.n / x.total AS share FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS x WHERE x.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS mean_n FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.n, s.share, s.n - x.mean_n AS excess FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 AS x WHERE x.mean_n IS NOT NULL AND s.n > x.mean_n) SELECT SUM(n), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM step5
